'''Tony Chen Jawa Scum And Villainy''' is a [[Dark]] Jawa list Tony Chen posted from leftover Jabba's Palace and Premiere cards.<ref name="list-45549">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/45549.html? swccg-discussion message #45549], [[Tony Chen]] (1 June 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000108215242/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/45549.html? Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Tony Chen]]
* '''Published:''' 1 June 1998 (swccg-discussion)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]] (from the card pool)
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Scum And Villainy|JP-D-scumandvillainy.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Jawa S&V Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PJP Jawa Chen DS 1998.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Chen asked the list to comment on a Jawa Scum And Villainy build.

== Strategy ==

Audience Chamber pulls Wittin. Scum And Villainy deploys Jawas and Jawa Packs. Ability, Ability, Ability and drains force an interactive game.
